sloka: प्रदोषकाले प्रविशं भीतया ऽहं तयोदितः ।अहं लङ्कापुरी वीर निर्जिता विक्रमेण ते ।। ५.५८.४९ ।।।।
transliteration: pradoṣakāle praviśaṁ bhītayā 'haṁ tayoditaḥ ।ahaṁ laṅkāpurī vīra nirjitā vikrameṇa te ।। 5.58.49 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then the frightening form, with its hair burning like sacrificial fire, emerged to kill me. I defeated her hittting with my left fist and entered the city at sunset time.
